seo.title: Rest Easy — Sleep Sounds for iOS
seo.description: Sleep sounds for better rest. Ambient soundscapes, custom mixing, sleep timer, and background playback. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: AMBIENT SOUNDSCAPES
hero.title: Sleep sounds for better rest.
text: Drift off with soothing ambient sounds. Mix your perfect soundscape, set a sleep timer, and let the sounds play all night.

screenshots.alt: Rest Easy — Drift Off to Sleep Sounds
screenshots.label: Drift Off to Sleep Sounds

items.title: Ambient Sounds
items.text: Rain, ocean waves, forest, wind, thunder, and more. High-quality, seamlessly looping soundscapes designed to help you relax and sleep.

items.title: Sound Mixing
items.text: Layer multiple sounds together and adjust individual volumes. Create your perfect combination — gentle rain with distant thunder, or ocean with soft wind.

items.title: Sleep Timer
items.text: Set sounds to fade out after a duration of your choice. Fall asleep to soothing audio without draining your battery all night.

items.title: Background Playback
items.text: Lock your phone, switch apps, or turn off the screen. Rest Easy keeps playing in the background so you can drift off undisturbed.

items.title: Dark Interface
items.text: A calming dark theme that won't disturb your eyes at bedtime. Minimal, distraction-free design built for nighttime use.

items.title: Completely Offline
items.text: All sounds are included in the app. No streaming, no downloads, no internet required. Works perfectly on airplane mode.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. Rest Easy doesn't make network requests. Your sleep habits are your business.

cta.title: Sleep better tonight.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
